btc_above_200w.note: SMA over completed calendar weeks only

btc_weekly_macd_8_21_5_hist_rising.note: MACD 8,21,5 on completed Monday to Sunday UTC weekly closes. EMA is seeded on the first value. Passes when the last complete bar's histogram is above zero and above the prior complete bar's.

btc_weekly_macd_8_21_5_fresh_cross.note: MACD 8,21,5 uses the same completed Monday to Sunday UTC weekly closes as the histogram rising row. EMA is seeded on the first value. The last complete histogram bar must be above zero. At least one of the three preceding bars must be at or below zero. This marks a bullish cross inside the last three weekly bars. cross_bar_date is the first bar after the most recent bar at or below zero. Entry timing, not a hold condition.

ladder_quantile.note: the page's own priceToQuantile under model v2, ported into this script. The centre line is 10 ** (5.645315 * log10(days since 2009-01-03) - 16.430264) and the lines are offsets c * exp(-age / T) in log10(price / centre). Passes is judged on model v1's quantile, not above its 85th band, because the 9/13 research measured that line. It is not the ladder's 75 sell line.

mstr_hidden_bull_div.note: higher swing low with lower RSI(14) at the two lows, swing = lowest low with 5 bars each side, 20-bar pair window, confirmed inside the last 10 bars

bollinger_tight.note: 20-day, 2 sigma, width = (upper - lower) / mid, percentile over trailing 252 days, tight = below 20

realized_vol_rank.note: 20-day realized vol, annualized at 252, percentile over trailing 252 days. A proxy for IV rank, not IV rank.

mstx_price.note: Yahoo daily close, delayed. Not a live quote.

components.label: BTC weekly MACD(8,21,5) histogram positive and rising
components.note: the 9/13 research's closest candidate. BTC 14-day hit 61.1% on 113 independent observations against a 56.8% base, Wilson lower bound 51.8%, and 54.8% out of sample since 2022. Beat its complement by 9 points on BTC 14-day and 16 on MSTR 10-day when paired with the ladder. Cleared the adoption bar nowhere. Paper only.

components.label: BTC weekly MACD(8,21,5) fresh cross (entry week)
components.note: the 9/13 research's entry-timing cell: 63.6% against a 56.8% base on 55 independent BTC 14-day signals, 68.6% against 51.6% on BTC 7-day since 2022 (the one cell that cleared the adoption bar). Entry timing, not a hold condition.

components.label: Quantile not above the 85th fitted band
components.note: the 9/13 research's other leg, the quantile not above the 85th fitted band. The ladder's sell line moved to 75 on 2026-09-20 and this leg stays at 85 until the research is rerun. The hit-rate gradient across bands is mostly a fitting artifact and collapses on a causal refit, but the drawdown gradient survives: the chance of a 10% drop inside two weeks runs 13% below the 15th band against 34% above the 85th. Pairing it with the weekly leg cut that chance from 24% to 14%. Cleared the adoption bar nowhere. Paper only.

paper_trigger.note: the 9/13 research's closest candidate: BTC weekly MACD(8,21,5) histogram positive and rising, plus the quantile not above the 85th fitted band. Beat its complement by 9 points on BTC 14-day and 16 on MSTR 10-day, cut the chance of a 10% drop inside two weeks from 24% to 14%, and cleared the adoption bar nowhere. Paper only.

paper_trigger_previous.note: the 9/12 MSTR backtest's two promising readings; kept for the ledger

entry_timing.note: the best week to open a new vertical is the cross week; the hold condition is the histogram rising row

leaps_unit.rule: the 40% funding test passes with room; re-quote before every entry

sources.prices: Yahoo Finance daily bars via yfinance. Delayed and unofficial.
sources.implied_vol: AlphaQuery 30-day mean IV (keyless chart endpoint) for the MSTR / MSTX / IBIT series and the IV rank; Yahoo's option-chain impliedVolatility field for the single mstr_atm_iv_30d row. Both delayed, neither a computed mid-market vol.
sources.iv_rank: Computed over data/iv-ledger.json, the AlphaQuery entries only, trailing 252 entries at most. Labelled with its window length and called a 52-week window only at a full 252 entries. A ticker whose fetch failed keeps its ledger reading, carries an error string with as_of_fetch null, and sets iv.stale.
sources.events: tools/events.json, hand maintained. Every row carries a verified flag and a source URL.
sources.rule_flags: tools/playbook_rules.json, hand maintained: backtest status plus the adopted flag plus the current and previous paper triggers.
sources.ladder_quantile: The page's own priceToQuantile ported into this script, scored at the Yahoo daily close and its own date. Not a second model, the same formula the ladder tab draws.
sources.rule: No field is ever a fabricated number. A source that fails is written as null with an error string.
